Gaxeo
Jan 2025 • Friends
Gaxeo is a vibrant and modern dining spot that brings together a fusion of flavors in a casual, trendy setting. The menu is diverse, offering a mix of traditional and contemporary dishes that cater to various tastes. The presentation of the food is always on point, with each dish looking as great as it tastes. The quality of the ingredients is evident in every bite, and the flavors are well-balanced.

The atmosphere is relaxed, with stylish decor that makes it a great place for both casual meals and more intimate gatherings. Service is friendly and efficient, ensuring a pleasant experience. Gaxeo is ideal for those looking to try new flavors in a laid-back yet fashionable environment, making it a fantastic option for lunch or dinner with friends or family.

Average food, okay for a fast food meal
May 2019 • Solo
It’s an okay spot for a fast food level meal, but in this city where there are so many delicious options, I regret spending one of my meals on Gaxeo’s. I ordered Spicy Boneless Chicken with Goat Cheese and the Honey Mustard French fries. I did like the flavor on the fries (I read another reviewer who had discouraged trying them) and I tried a Korean liquor that was new to me (though I have seen it since at local Circle K’s). Better than going to McDonalds, but still not worth spending a HCMC meal on.

Turned away not just once but twice
Feb 2019 • Couples
We tried to eat at this establishment twice today. We entered the first time at 2:37 pm. and were told the restaurant was closed and would open at 8 pm. Turned away for the first time. 

We returned at 8:17 pm. and were told they were closed. We were not allowed to sit down. There were others eating and one table was in the process of ordering. Turned away for the second time within the SAME day. 

I am not going to make any allegations but I don't think you have to be a rocket scientist to draw the conclusion we came up with. 

DO NOT EAT AT THIS ESTABLISHMENT. If this is any indication of the level of service they provide the meal will be horrendous. 

DO NOT SUPPORT THIS ESTABLISHMENT.
